system.longDesc: You are skilled in reconnaissance and infiltration.

degree0.desc: If you fail a Dexterity (Stealth) test, you can re-roll it but must keep the results of the second roll.

degree1.desc: You know how to get the drop on opponents. You can perform the Seize the Initiative stunt for 2 SP.

degree2.desc: You are a skilled observer. If you fail a Perception (Seeing) test, you can re-roll it but must keep the results of the second roll.
